r.cau: Bo luat QUAN LI LENH (buoc, he so lot, tran tang, tp, cat/giu, gio dung) cua cac he luoi/DCA song >=2 nam tren MQL5 (31 ung vien, 18 luoi/DCA) SUY RA DUOC tu lich su lenh (tab History) + gia that, va chay lai bang engine cua ta (nhan/luoi.py) o cung cap/khung cho lai sau phi + maxDD<80% cung bac voi duong von cong bo.
r.vi_sao: Day la cach ngan nhat tu 'dang ra tien' sang 'cua ta' (LUAT SO 0): khong doan luat, ma BOC no tu lenh that - tang cach nhau bao nhieu pip, lot nhan the nao, dong ca ro khi nao (mo_xe_lenh / boc_lich_su da co). Chu du an: nhieu bot danh kieu quan li lenh ma ta chua boc tach va khai thac. Cua nghen: bang lenh CHUA keo ve (mql5 chi ra duoc tu may nha) -> can may nha chay don lay lich su.

r.cau: KIEM CHUNG gia thuyet 'quan li lenh quyet dinh, entry khong': trong CUNG luat quan li luoi, doi entry 'vao ngay' bang (a) entry co tin hieu xu huong, (b) entry hoi quy, (c) entry ngau nhien cung tan suat -> lai sau phi khong khac nhau qua do lech giua cac o lan can tren tai san hoi quy; DONG THOI chuoi random walk (cung bien do, khong chi phi) cho ty le o co lai bang bao nhieu thi 'co lai trong mau' cua luoi KHONG duoc coi la bang chung.
r.vi_sao: Luoi/DCA co phan phoi loi nhuan lech am (thu nho deu, mat lon hiem): quet nhieu o tren chuoi that LUON tim duoc o co lai trong mau, ke ca khi chuoi khong co gi (ky vong duoi random walk = -chi phi, nhan/pmg). Can mot phep HIEU CHUAN HAI CHIEU: ty le o co lai tren random walk (null) va tren chuoi hoi quy co dap an (AR am). Khong phai cong chan - la nhan canh bao do tin; cong chan van la lai sau phi + maxDD<80% + dung cua so. Phep do dung quet_luoi voi truc che_do/cho_lui/tia_lenh va ma TONG HOP lam doi chung.

r.cau: Tren tai san HOI QUY (cap cheo FX, vang) mot bo quy tac QUAN LI LENH (luoi/DCA: buoc, tp, tran_tang, kieu lot, cho_lui) co lai sau phi + maxDD<80% o dung don bay ngay ca khi entry chi la 'vao ngay lap tuc' khong tin hieu; them entry co tin hieu khong tang lai on dinh. Tren tai san XU HUONG (chi so, US100) cung bo quy tac do KHONG co lai.
r.vi_sao: Nguoi tra tien: thi truong tra phi cho ben cung cap thanh khoan ngan han (ban bao hiem duoi: thu deu khi gia hoi quy, chiu cu sut lon khi xu huong) - tien den tu bat doi xung cua luat quan li lenh tren tai san hoi quy, khong tu du doan huong. Bang chung gian tiep (nguon gia thuyet, CHUA phai bang chung): G0 14/09 cap cheo FX + vang hoi quy o moi thang do (AUDCAD/EURGBP 8/8, XAUUSDM 7/8), chi so 0-1/8 (US100 0/8); 18/31 nguoi thang MQL5 song >=2 nam la luoi/DCA tren AUDCAD va anh em (tai_lieu/NGUON_NGUOI_THANG.md). Neu dung thi QUYET DINH ENTRY THAT = chon TAI SAN + KHUNG; luat quan li quyet dinh lai va maxDD. Chu du an 03/10: 'xu li lenh tot thi khong can quan tam entry'.

r.cau: AUDCAD luoi hai chieu (lot 0.01 tang tuyen tinh, buoc ~21 pip, TP ~7.6 pip, tia lenh) co lai sau phi tren M15 kham_pha 2018-2023, tuc TRUOC khi con 2023752 bat dau
r.vi_sao: con 2023752 song 2,2 nam, 99% ro co lai, 61% lai tu ro 1 lenh; neu cai dat nay co lai tren 5,5 nam truoc con thi la co che (AUDCAD hoi quy hep, G0 14/09), neu khong thi con chi gap may hoac thich nghi che do 2023-2026
